description: Snapshot of publicly listed EV charging locations in and around Bengaluru, copied field by field from individual Open Charge Map location pages. PUBLIC LISTING data only: no live status.
retrieval_method: Manual web retrieval of each OCM location page (openchargemap.org/poi/details/<id>) on 2026-10-23; values copied verbatim. Usage cost currency is not stated by OCM.
attribution: Open Charge Map (https://openchargemap.org) and its contributors, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
notes: Several OCM pages show a 'Number of stations/bays' that does not match the connector quantities; connector rows are stored as listed.
Jio-BP Pulse Hub, Marathalli (OCM-309317) listed eight separate 60 kW CCS rows of 2 connectors each; they are summed here (16).
Novotel Bengaluru Outer Ring Road (OCM-308811): the postcode is shown as '5700103' on the source page and is kept verbatim.
Where an OCM page lists several identical connector rows (e.g. seven rows of 2 x 60 kW CCS), their quantities are summed into one row.
